items.docs: Combines authorization and reporting in a single call. Authorizes the API call and simultaneously reports usage metrics to 3scale. This is the recommended approach for reporting hits and other metrics.

Reports multiple API usage transactions in batch to 3scale. Used to asynchronously report usage metrics after API calls have already been processed. Supports reporting for multiple application keys in a single call.
